# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for the nightly TSan job.
# Qt is not built with -fsanitize=thread, so its internal synchronisation is
# invisible to TSan and every cross-thread signal looks like a race. Reports
# that begin inside Qt's own libraries are dropped; anything left points into
# heap's code and is worth a look.
called_from_lib:libQt6Core.so
called_from_lib:libQt6Gui.so
called_from_lib:libQt6Network.so
called_from_lib:libQt6Qml.so
called_from_lib:libQt6Quick.so
called_from_lib:libQt6DBus.so
called_from_lib:libQt6NetworkAuth.so
